g.text: • Task classification → routeTask(query, fileCount) → model tier
• llama-server local mode on :8080 for offline use
• Loaded from project, global, and OpenCode configs
DAEMON AUTOFIX PIPELINE (mtc daemon — autonomous, headless)
• Uses the same LLM Engine + Tool Registry • GitHub only (GitLab webhooks acknowledged but rejected) • max concurrent jobs guard • security: validateCloneUrl / validateFilePath
• Notifications via notifier.ts → Slack + Teams webhooks • Job tracked in-memory (pipeline.ts activeJobs)
Also in the enterprise tier: audit logs, org management, RBAC, web dashboard (src/enterprise/dashboard.ts), realtime updates, exports.
Eval & benchmarking (mtc eval run/bench) drive the real agent loop against sandboxed tasks in tests/evals/.
Telemetry (opt-in) records session/tool/model analytics locally — never file contents.
